mapper.select: SELECT /* getPopupContentDtl */ POPUP.POPU_SITU , POPUP.POPU_CODE , POPUP.CONT_FIRS , POPUP.CONT_SECO , POPUP.CONT_THIR , POPUP.CONT_FOUR FROM CT_POPUPX POPUP INNER JOIN TB_CODEXD SITU ON SITU.COMM_CODE = #{codePopuSitu} AND SITU.COMD_CODE = POPUP.POPU_SITU AND COALESCE(SITU.USEE_YSNO, #{commYes}) = #{commYes} WHERE POPUP.POPU_SITU = #{popuSitu} AND POPUP.POPU_CODE = #{popuCode}
